thesis: Public news may reprice less-followed event markets slowly enough to offer after-cost value.
universe: binary event contracts on Polymarket and Kalshi; exclude asset-price bets
trigger: A new primary release materially changes an event probability.
entry_rule: Find the primary release, compare its timestamp with the quote, state a base rate and evidence-driven probability update.
exit_rule: Official settlement, price invalidation, target, or stated horizon; up to one year.
sizing_hints: Buy YES or NO with cash. Half Kelly with driver and position caps. No naked shorts.
